sources.title: TinyViT Model | ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides a comprehensive technical overview of the TinyViT model architecture - the lightweight image encoder that serves as the backbone of MobileSAM. TinyViT replaces the heavyweight ViT-H encoder used in the original SAM model, achieving significant efficiency improvements while maintaining segmentation capabilities.
